name: showup
description: Turn real work into social drafts in Steven's voice and queue approved content for review.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your work into posts that sound like you.
interface.longDescription: Uses evidence from your work, your saved ideas, and your writing preferences to create relatable X and LinkedIn drafts. It can save drafts to Typefully, but public posting always stays under your control.
defaultPrompt: Turn today's work into two post ideas.
Rewrite this so it sounds like me.
Save the approved draft to Typefully.
